latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the invoice-expense-categoriser skill.
- Categorises UK business expenses and invoices according to HMRC Self Assessment (SA103) categories.
- Generates quarterly profit & loss summaries, VAT-ready reports, and MTD-compatible breakdowns from raw transaction data.
- Supports multiple input modes: pasting transactions, describing expenses in natural language, batch (month/quarter) processing, and single expense queries.
- Provides flagging and guidance for capital allowances and home office expense claims.
- Includes required disclaimer for users to confirm categorisation with their accountant.
